resume_text: Financial Analyst with 5+ years of experience in IT financial planning and analysis. Led Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) audit documentation and control testing for three consecutive fiscal years. Financial Analyst

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have):

- Experience with capital budget cycle development
